title: When Does Oversampling Help? A Decision Framework for Imbalanced Data Streams Under Label Delay and Concept Drift
abstract: arXiv:2611.17981v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: For imbalanced data streams with delayed labels, is it worth adding a streaming oversampler, or does continuous re-evaluation of earlier predictions already recover the cost of the delay? We address this through an extensive experimental comparison of streaming oversampling and continuous re-evaluation under joint class imbalance, concept drift, and label delay. Streaming oversamplers are typically evaluated under the test-then-train assumption of immediate labels; their behaviour under these conditions, assessed through re-evaluation, has not been systematically studied. We close this gap with a decision framework that predicts when oversampling adds value over re-evaluation, organised around three axes: drift density, minority-class learnability, and delay relative to the refinement window, and operationalised as a competition between a recovery channel (re-evaluation) and a minority-coverage channel (oversampling). translated_title: 何时过采样才有帮助？标签延迟与概念漂移下不平衡数据流的决策框架
translated_abstract: 对于标签延迟的不平衡数据流，添加一个流式过采样器是否值得，还是对早期预测进行持续重评估已经足以弥补延迟带来的代价？我们通过在类别不平衡、概念漂移与标签延迟三者共同作用的条件下，对流式过采样与持续重评估进行广泛的实验比较来回答这一问题。流式过采样器通常在标签即时可得的“先测试后训练”（test-then-train）假设下被评估；而在此条件下通过重评估来考察其行为的研究尚未被系统地开展过。我们通过一个决策框架填补了这一空白，该框架能够预测过采样何时比重评估更有价值，围绕三个维度组织：漂移密度、少数类的可学习性，以及延迟相对于细化窗口的时长，并将该问题具体化为两条通道之间的竞争——恢复通道（重评估）与少数类覆盖通道（过采样）。在对15个分类器（原文摘要在此截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个围绕漂移密度、少数类可学习性和延迟相对于细化窗口时长这三个维度构建的决策框架，用于预测在标签延迟与概念漂移并存的不平衡数据流中，流式过采样何时能比持续重评估带来额外价值。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a decision framework, organized around three axes—drift density, minority-class learnability, and delay relative to the refinement window—that predicts when streaming oversampling adds value over continuous re-evaluation for imbalanced data streams under label delay and concept drift.
